# make_surface_trace { #mofography.movies.make_surface_trace }

```python
movies.make_surface_trace(
    dgrid,
    regions,
    atoms,
    isovalue=1.0,
    step_size=2,
    style='surface',
    name='Surface',
    trace_id='surface',
    cscale=None,
    hover_prefix=None,
    taubin_smooth=False,
    taubin_iterations=10,
    taubin_lambda=0.5,
    taubin_nu=-0.53,
)
```

Build a Three.js colored isosurface mesh trace from dgrid and region labels.
